messages.author: Laura Lahti
messages.text: The Ounasvaara hop is throwing CRC errors since this morning. Alignment and RX levels look fine.

messages.author: Sanna Saari
messages.text: Check the IF cable connector at the indoor unit first, water gets in there in spring. Clean it and re-tape it before you touch the radio.

messages.author: Laura Lahti
messages.text: Cleaned and re-taped the connector, CRC errors are gone. Thanks!
